::: {.lead}
How does the world's coldest national capital compare to sunny Florida? Explore 2023 temperature and rainfall patterns between **Sarasota, FL** and **Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia**.
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
### 🌡️ At a Glance
- **Sarasota:** Warm year-round, with more rainfall than Ulaanbaatar in this 2023 dataset.
- **Ulaanbaatar:** Dramatic seasonal swings—warm summers followed by sub-zero winter extremes below -30°F.
:::

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from datetime import datetime
from meteostat import config, hourly

config.block_large_requests = False

start = datetime(2020, 1, 1)
end = datetime(2024, 12, 31, 23, 59)

stations = {
    "Sarasota": "KSRQ0",
    "Ulaanbaatar": "44292",
}

records = []

for city, station in stations.items():
    df = hourly(station, start, end).fetch()
    if df is None or df.empty:
        continue

    df = df.reset_index().rename(columns={"time": "date"})
    df = df[["date", "temp", "prcp"]].dropna().copy()
    df["city"] = city
    df = df.rename(columns={"temp": "temp_c", "prcp": "rainfall_mm"})
    df["temp_f"] = (df["temp_c"] * 9 / 5) + 32
    temperature_limits = {"Sarasota": (-10, 115), "Ulaanbaatar": (-60, 110)}
    lower, upper = temperature_limits[city]
    df = df[df["temp_f"].between(lower, upper)]
    records.append(df)

daily_df = pd.concat(records, ignore_index=True)
daily_df = daily_df.sort_values(["city", "date"]).reset_index(drop=True)
daily_df["year"] = daily_df["date"].dt.year
daily_df["day"] = daily_df["date"].dt.date
cities = ["Sarasota", "Ulaanbaatar"]
shared_days = daily_df.groupby("day")["city"].nunique()
daily_df = daily_df[
    daily_df["day"].isin(shared_days[shared_days == len(cities)].index)
].copy()
years_by_city = [
    set(daily_df.loc[daily_df["city"] == city, "year"].unique())
    for city in cities
]
years = sorted(set.intersection(*years_by_city))
year_range = f"{years[0]}–{years[-1]}"
year_ranges = daily_df.groupby("year")["date"].agg(["min", "max"]).to_dict("index")
year_titles = {
    year: (
        f"Hourly Temperature Readings Across {year} "
        f"({dates['min']:%b %d}–{dates['max']:%b %d})"
    )
    for year, dates in year_ranges.items()
}
all_title = (
    f"Hourly Temperature Readings Across {year_range} "
    f"({daily_df['date'].min():%b %d, %Y}–{daily_df['date'].max():%b %d, %Y})"
)
```

## Hourly Temperature Comparison

```{python}
city_colors = {"Sarasota": "#e76f51", "Ulaanbaatar": "#277da1"}
fig_temp = go.Figure()

for year in years:
    for city, color in city_colors.items():
        year_city = daily_df[(daily_df["year"] == year) & (daily_df["city"] == city)]
        fig_temp.add_trace(go.Scattergl(
            x=year_city["date"],
            y=year_city["temp_f"],
            mode="markers",
            name=city,
            legendgroup=city,
            marker=dict(color=color, size=4, opacity=0.55),
            visible=False,
            hovertemplate=(
                "%{x|%b %d, %Y %H:%M}<br>"
                f"{city}: %{{y:.1f}} °F<extra></extra>"
            )
        ))

for city, color in city_colors.items():
    all_city = daily_df[daily_df["city"] == city]
    fig_temp.add_trace(go.Scattergl(
        x=all_city["date"],
        y=all_city["temp_f"],
        mode="markers",
        name=city,
        legendgroup=city,
        marker=dict(color=color, size=3, opacity=0.3),
        hovertemplate=(
            "%{x|%b %d, %Y %H:%M}<br>"
            f"{city}: %{{y:.1f}} °F<extra></extra>"
        )
    ))

dropdown_buttons = []
for index, year in enumerate(years):
    visible = [False] * (len(years) * len(city_colors) + len(city_colors))
    visible[index * len(city_colors):(index + 1) * len(city_colors)] = [True] * len(city_colors)
    dropdown_buttons.append(dict(
        label=str(year),
        method="update",
        args=[{"visible": visible}, {"title": year_titles[year]}]
    ))

dropdown_buttons.append(dict(
    label="All",
    method="update",
    args=[
        {"visible": [False] * (len(years) * len(city_colors)) + [True] * len(city_colors)},
        {"title": all_title}
    ]
))

fig_temp.add_hline(
    y=32,
    line_dash="dot",
    line_color="#6b7280",
    annotation_text="Freezing: 32°F",
    annotation_position="top left"
)

fig_temp.update_layout(
    template="plotly_white",
    height=500,
    title=all_title,
    xaxis_title="Date",
    yaxis_title="Temperature (°F)",
    margin=dict(t=125, l=60, r=30, b=50),
    updatemenus=[dict(
        buttons=dropdown_buttons,
        direction="down",
        showactive=True,
        x=0.5,
        xanchor="center",
        y=1.16,
        yanchor="top"
    )]
)
fig_temp.show()
```

Use the dropdown to compare a single shared year or all available shared years together. Ulaanbaatar drops far below 32°F in winter and rises to warm summer highs, while Sarasota stays relatively mild all year.

## Hourly Rainfall Comparison

```{python}
fig_rain = go.Figure()

for year in years:
    for city, color in city_colors.items():
        year_city = daily_df[(daily_df["year"] == year) & (daily_df["city"] == city)]
        fig_rain.add_trace(go.Scattergl(
            x=year_city["date"],
            y=year_city["rainfall_mm"],
            mode="markers",
            name=city,
            legendgroup=city,
            marker=dict(color=color, size=4, opacity=0.55),
            visible=False,
            hovertemplate=(
                "%{x|%b %d, %Y %H:%M}<br>"
                f"{city}: %{{y:.2f}} mm<extra></extra>"
            )
        ))

for city, color in city_colors.items():
    all_city = daily_df[daily_df["city"] == city]
    fig_rain.add_trace(go.Scattergl(
        x=all_city["date"],
        y=all_city["rainfall_mm"],
        mode="markers",
        name=city,
        legendgroup=city,
        marker=dict(color=color, size=3, opacity=0.3),
        hovertemplate=(
            "%{x|%b %d, %Y %H:%M}<br>"
            f"{city}: %{{y:.2f}} mm<extra></extra>"
        )
    ))

rain_dropdown_buttons = []
for index, year in enumerate(years):
    visible = [False] * (len(years) * len(city_colors) + len(city_colors))
    visible[index * len(city_colors):(index + 1) * len(city_colors)] = [True] * len(city_colors)
    rain_dropdown_buttons.append(dict(
        label=str(year),
        method="update",
        args=[
            {"visible": visible},
            {"title": f"Hourly Rainfall Readings Across {year} "
                       f"({year_ranges[year]['min']:%b %d}–{year_ranges[year]['max']:%b %d})"}
        ]
    ))

rain_dropdown_buttons.append(dict(
    label="All",
    method="update",
    args=[
        {"visible": [False] * (len(years) * len(city_colors)) + [True] * len(city_colors)},
        {"title": f"Hourly Rainfall Readings Across {year_range} "
                   f"({daily_df['date'].min():%b %d, %Y}–{daily_df['date'].max():%b %d, %Y})"}
    ]
))

fig_rain.update_layout(
    template="plotly_white",
    height=500,
    title=f"Hourly Rainfall Readings Across {year_range}",
    xaxis_title="Date",
    yaxis_title="Rainfall (mm)",
    yaxis=dict(rangemode="tozero"),
    margin=dict(t=125, l=60, r=30, b=50),
    updatemenus=[dict(
        buttons=rain_dropdown_buttons,
        direction="down",
        showactive=True,
        x=0.5,
        xanchor="center",
        y=1.16,
        yanchor="top"
    )]
)
fig_rain.show()
```

Use the dropdown to compare one shared year or all available shared years. Ulaanbaatar has a distinct summer rainfall pulse, while Sarasota shows heavier rainfall across more of the year.

## Overall summary

This summary uses the same shared-date, quality-filtered hourly observations shown in the charts. The average, coldest, and hottest temperatures describe individual hourly readings; total rainfall is the sum of the available hourly precipitation measurements.

```{python}
summary = (
    daily_df.groupby("city")
    .agg(
        coverage=("date", lambda values: f"{values.min():%b %d, %Y}–{values.max():%b %d, %Y}"),
        hourly_observations=("temp_f", "count"),
        average_temp_f=("temp_f", "mean"),
        coldest_temp_f=("temp_f", "min"),
        hottest_temp_f=("temp_f", "max"),
        total_rainfall_mm=("rainfall_mm", "sum"),
    )
    .rename(
        columns={
            "coverage": "Coverage",
            "hourly_observations": "Hourly observations",
            "average_temp_f": "Average temperature (°F)",
            "coldest_temp_f": "Coldest observation (°F)",
            "hottest_temp_f": "Hottest observation (°F)",
            "total_rainfall_mm": "Total rainfall (mm)",
        }
    )
)

summary_style = (
    summary.style
    .format({
        "Hourly observations": "{:,.0f}",
        "Average temperature (°F)": "{:.1f}",
        "Coldest observation (°F)": "{:.1f}",
        "Hottest observation (°F)": "{:.1f}",
        "Total rainfall (mm)": "{:,.1f}",
    })
    .set_caption("Summary of valid shared-date observations")
    .set_table_styles([
        {
            "selector": "caption",
            "props": [
                ("caption-side", "top"),
                ("color", "#16324f"),
                ("font-size", "1.05rem"),
                ("font-weight", "600"),
                ("padding", "0 0 .75rem"),
                ("text-align", "left"),
            ],
        },
        {
            "selector": "thead th",
            "props": [
                ("background-color", "#277da1"),
                ("color", "white"),
                ("font-weight", "600"),
                ("padding", ".75rem"),
                ("text-align", "left"),
            ],
        },
        {
            "selector": "tbody th",
            "props": [
                ("background-color", "#eaf4f7"),
                ("color", "#16324f"),
                ("font-weight", "700"),
                ("padding", ".75rem"),
            ],
        },
        {
            "selector": "tbody td",
            "props": [
                ("border-bottom", "1px solid #d7e6ea"),
                ("padding", ".75rem"),
            ],
        },
        {
            "selector": "tbody tr:nth-child(even) td",
            "props": [("background-color", "#f7fbfc")],
        },
        {
            "selector": "tbody tr:hover td",
            "props": [("background-color", "#fff1ec")],
        },
    ])
)
summary_style
```
